unresolved_questions: Confirm that a USB-to-UART bridge is the intended programming path. The specified ESP32-WROOM-32 does not provide native USB, so USB D+/D- are not compatible with direct connection to that module; the alternative is changing to a native-USB ESP32 variant.
Select and validate the exact regulator and VBUS protection devices, including efficiency and thermal margin at 4.75 V input, 600 mA output, and 85 degC ambient.
Confirm whether the assumed BOM and bare-board cost limits are binding before component and distributor selection.
Define the layout-approved TMP102 thermal-isolation geometry that interrupts heat-spreading copper while preserving a short, controlled electrical ground return.
Choose the exact 16-pin or 24-pin USB-C receptacle footprint and confirm distributor stock and board-edge mechanical fit.
